== Build notes: game overview and online play ==

Expanded the game overview with original publisher artwork, credited creators and documented publication history, and added the direct TCGMix destination with its verified preserved copy. Existing article material was retained. Original publication and subsequent online implementations are treated separately.

== TheForce.Net forum source ==

[[Special:PermanentLink/104104|The earlier article revision]] reads, “Early SWCCG players on TheForce.Net boards called it a possible "side game" rather than a replacement.” and gives the original citation. Direct access returned a browser-validation page, the VPS browser received an HTTP 503 error, and Wayback had no usable replay after a save returned HTTP 520. The preserved TheForce.Net review describes fans’ mixed reactions. The specific forum wording still needs independent confirmation.

The newly supplied YouTube preserved-copy links were checked as watch-page documents, including video identity, description and timestamp. They do not establish preservation or a new review of the audio or video. Existing interview claims and transcript links remain separate evidence.
